Feature: Hospital Staff Information Acquisition and Feedback

Scenario Outline: Hospital Staff interacts with the system to acquire and provide feedback

  Given the system is operational
  When hospital staff accesses the system
  Then they should be able to acquire patient information
  And they should be able to provide feedback on the system requirements

Examples:
  | Role       | Information Source | Feedback Type | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Chemist    | Lab Results        | Positive       | Lab results are accurately reflected in the system |
  | Patient    | Medical History    | Negative       | Medical history is not fully captured in the system |
  | Lab Staff  | Test Results       | Edge          | Test results are partially reflected in the system |
  | Nurse      | Patient Observations | Invalid       | Observations are not recognized by the system |

Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development team analyzes and implements the system

  Given the system requirements are provided
  When the team reviews the requirements
  Then they should be able to analyze and implement the system

Examples:
  | Role       | Requirement Source | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Mishal     | Project Requirements | System is designed according to project needs |
  | Samyak     | Development Requirements | System is developed with necessary features |

attempts.artifact:
Feature: Hospital Staff Information Acquisition and Feedback

  Scenario Outline: Hospital Staff identifies patient information and provides feedback

    Given the hospital staff has access to patient data
    When they review patient information
    Then they identify relevant details
    And they provide feedback on the system requirements

    Examples:
      | Patient Data Type | Details Identified | Feedback Provided |
      | Normal           | Full Name, Age       | Positive, Specific |
      | Edge Case        | Missing Age, Full Name | Negative, General |
      | Invalid Case     | Non-Existent Name     | Invalid, Error |

  Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development team analyzes feedback

    Given the feedback from hospital staff
    When the team reviews the feedback
    Then they analyze the requirements
    And they plan modifications to the system

    Examples:
      | Feedback Type | Requirements Identified | Modifications Planned |
      | Positive       | Full Name, Age        | Add new fields, improve UI |
      | Negative       | Missing Age, Full Name | Remove fields, simplify UI |
      | Invalid        | Non-Existent Name     | Error handling, validation |

Feature: Reference Document for Project Management and Development

  Scenario Outline: The document serves as a reference for the team

    Given the document exists
    When the team accesses the document
    Then they understand the project requirements
    And they use it for development planning

    Examples:
      | Document Type | Understanding | Usage |
      | Project Plan | Clear, Detailed | Strategic, Tactical |
      | Requirements | Specific, Detailed | Strategic, Tactical |
